hero.main_statement: HELLO! I'M BASITH, A SOFTWARE ENGINEER & AI BUILDER BUILDING WEB PLATFORMS, AI SYSTEMS & AUTOMATION FROM SRI LANKA.

about.title: I BUILD MODERN, SECURE, AND SCALABLE DIGITAL SOLUTIONS WITH A PASSION FOR WEB DEVELOPMENT
about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate digital designer and web developer focused on creating user-centered digital experiences. I blend creativity with clean, efficient code to build websites that are not only visually appealing but also functional, fast, and reliable.
about.paragraph2: With a strong eye for design & a solid technical foundation, I transform complex ideas into simple, intuitive digital solutions. I believe great design is purposefully laid out, interaction, and line of code is crafted to enhance usability and deliver real value.
about.paragraph3: From concept to launch, I work closely with clients to understand their goals, audience and brand vision. My collaborative approach ensures each project reflects the client's identity with focused objectives and performance standards.
